explanation: From AP=PJ, the first column must satisfy (A-3I)v=0. Here (A-3I)x=(-4,-4,2)^T, (A-3I)y=(0,0,0)^T, and (A-3I)z=(4,4,-4)^T. Only y qualifies. It can start the required Jordan chain because (A-3I)(0,-1/2,1/2)^T=y; together with the eigenvector (0,0,1)^T for eigenvalue 4, these give an invertible P.
